correctness.rationale: The exact Meijer-G expression gives the uniform unlogged expansion \(\mathfrak t_\beta(X)=\cos(\pi\beta)+(2\beta/\pi)\sin(\pi\beta)\,XL^2+O(XL)\). With \(\delta=\tfrac12-\beta\), the singular coefficient is \(1/(\pi^2\delta)\). Splitting the min-entropy integral at \(\delta\) comparable to \(\varepsilon=XL^2\) gives \((\varepsilon/\pi^2)\log(1/\varepsilon)+O(\varepsilon)\), hence the stated asymptotic. The proof does not exchange a nonuniform fixed-\(\beta\) limit with the integral.
